reviews.text: I had an outstanding experience at DJ Tire and Auto Repair. They took me in immediately with no wait and replaced my two front struts perfectly. Their expertise was evident in the quality of their work, and my car now makes no strange sounds on the road. I highly recommend them for any auto repair needs. Very reasonable prices - Ladies they will not rip you off.  Truly top-notch, no-frills service!
reviews.author: Fatima A

reviews.text: Impressed with how smoothly it went. Everything was handled professionally.
